column3: Macronix, Winbond post record July revenue as memory prices rise
column4: Taiwan memory chipmakers Macronix International and Winbond Electronics both posted record monthly revenue in July, extending strong second-quarter momentum as tight supply and rising memory prices continue to lift profitability.

column3: Innodisk posts record second quarter profit on AI and memory demand
column4: Innodisk reported record second-quarter 2026 results as surging memory prices and artificial intelligence demand lifted profit, revenue, and margins. The memory module maker said quarterly net profit reached NT$10.368 billion, with earnings per share reaching NT$108.93.

column3: VSO's Vietnam expansion and AI-server growth point to bigger upside, but memory shortages cloud the outlook
column4: VSO Electronics said its Vietnam plant is on track for trial production by the end of December 2026 as it expands its presence in AI server applications, liquid-cooling leak detection, and high-speed cables. The company is also preparing for tighter supply conditions in the second half of 2026, especially in memory.
